mistakes.title: Common Mistakes We Help New Brands Avoid
mistakes.description: Launching a beauty brand can be tricky. Here are key pitfalls our Marrakech production team helps you navigate.

items.title: Launching Too Many Products At Once
items.body: Start with 2–3 flagship products (like Argan Oil & Black Soap), test your market, and expand based on real reorders.
items.solution: Focus your initial capital on marketing your core hero products.

items.title: Designing Labels Before Compliance Checks
items.body: Designing labels without leaving exact space for mandatory INCI names, batch numbers, net content, and responsible person address.
items.solution: We provide exact label template dimensions before you finalize artwork.

items.title: Misusing "Organic" & Certification Logos
items.body: Placing raw material organic logos on finished products without verifying white label branding permissions.
items.solution: We guide you on legal claim wording for your specific target country.

items.title: Choosing Clear Glass Bottles For Sensitive Oils
items.body: Selecting clear glass solely for photos, exposing UV-sensitive oils like Argan and Prickly Pear to light degradation.
items.solution: Opt for amber, dark green, or frosted glass to preserve oil potency.

items.title: Underestimating Reorder Lead Times
items.body: Waiting until stock is completely sold out before reordering custom bottles or specialized formulas.
items.solution: Set an automatic reorder point when inventory reaches 30%.
